Hi, Au,
Thanks for your information.
Below is the unit price we can do for you.
USD$140: 5-port managed
USD$195: 8-port managed
USD$170: 8-port unmanaged

For a bulk order, lets discuss.
Example: its 185usd for the sample unit(8-port managed), as I explained before, it is the bulk price.
Honestly we can do better based on the quantity(5-port managed and 8-port managed).
For 8-port unmanaged, it is not easy to give a discount(the profit is thin now), but it depends on cases.

Regarding the price comparison
1, shipping cost is not much from China to Singapore especially when the quantity is more.
The CIF price will be lower.
Example: the model you purchased is 1pc, 25usd shipping cost.
CIF price: 210usd/pc
I just checked, if you do 10pcs, shipping cost will be 80usd
CIF price: 193usd/pc
If you order more, product unit price will be lower, shipping cost will not increase too much, CIF price will be more competitive.
So it is just about more pieces, the average price(CIF price) will be better.

2, I think our price advantage is the 5-port and 8-port managed model.
As I said above, we can give a further discount if the quantity is good.
But for 8-port unmanaged, it seems not very competitive.
I compared the price SGD$270: TL-SX1008: 8-port unmanaged with 3 years warranty
Its about 207usd, compared with our offer 170usd+shipping cost, it is not competitive enough.
If this is a decent order of mixed models(managed and unmanaged), we will do our best to give a further discount(an extreme situation, we make the profit very very thin, we still have some profit from managed models), this is what I wrote above, it depends on cases.

3, In our daily work, some clients will also ask us below questions
How is your product better than some famous brands?
Why do I have to choose your products?
...
Honestly if it is not a bulk order, it is not easy to compete with some famous brands like TPlink or Planet.
They have better technical strength, they manufacture in batches each time(because clients around the world accept their brand, never worry about the selling issue).
For us, the R&D cost is usually higher and we mostly give the very best prices based on bulk orders(we need to think about selling and profit).
So this is very different.
However, we still have our own advantage.
1, as I explained, our prices are not higher than TPlink though some prices are not very competitive.
2, we support customization and do our best to support you(for some famous brands, customization is not very easy)

With all that said, I think you should understand this situation.
We have pros and cons compared with some famous brands, it depends on your business plan.
If you decide to promote your own brand, maybe it is an option to customize something, we can do this for you easily.
If it is just about selling something locally, just push for better prices.
Either way, I think you could work out something based on our offer, and we will do our best to support you, every question every detail...

Hopefully this lengthy explanation will be useful to enhance your understanding our business ideas/positioning.
Please let me know your feedback.
Thank you.

Hello Simon,
 
looking forward to your alleycat5 based models, please consider adding standard tachometer/PWN fan monitoring/control + temperature monitoring too.
 
The most important missing SNMP MIBs are LLDP neighbors via the LLDP-V2-MIB: https://mibs.observium.org/mib/LLDP-V2-MIB/#lldpV2MIB and transceiver DDM monitoring data.
We need the LLDP MIB to allow our monitoring system to automatically detect how the switches are connected together and create some maps from this data.
DDM data is needed to have long term monitoring data of the transceivers (so we can e.g. detect laser or fiber degradation).
With power/temperature/fan monitoring, of course this data should be available via SNMP too.
 
Regarding the media converters: your price for the 10G model was very high and we tested a marvel based on from another supplier, unfortunately it doesn’t support 1G/10G mixed operation either. If you are aware of any other media converter/small switch based solution which can handle e.g. 10G SFP+ and 1G BASE-T, we’re open to suggestions.
